'''Joka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during [[Alderaan Civil War|the planet's civil war]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Joka also appears as stim-vendor for the warzone "[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]] Ruins" in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
